M1.title: Curve and variable offset
M1.notes: No plate-specific calibration. Native dash patterns and offset interpolation differ.

M2.title: Variable-width brush
M2.notes: Calibrated mode changes the width law to match the source's offset-fit envelope. It is not a same-width-law comparison.

M3.title: Latitude spheres
M3.notes: Nominal mode replays MetaPost's scaled random stream for sphere-latitude brush dashes. Calibrated mode uses seed 15 and remains a visual-only comparison.

M4.title: Longitudinal arc tube
M4.notes: The centerline is sampled from the pinned MetaPost path at 1/8 path-time intervals (321 points), replacing the ideal-circle approximation. This lowers nominal 600 ppi RMSE from 0.07025 to 0.06050; ink coverage is 1.756% vs 1.789% in the source. The renderer uses rng: metapost for longitudinal hatch dashes and source-unit-aware 16.16 thin-brush width-level rounding. Calibrated mode slightly increases maximum hatch width (TeX pt).

M5.title: Suspended sphere composite
M5.notes: Native annotation and arrow construction differ. MetaPost draws the tube before the sphere and uses one global RNG. Use C1 for an isolated sphere measurement.

M6.title: Variable-radius closed tube and taper
M6.notes: Typst reverses the sine sign to account for its opposite circle traversal; this is coordinate conversion. Calibrated mode changes the seed of both tubes.

M7.title: Transverse tube
M7.notes: Calibrated mode changes the dash period (TeX pt). Both modes keep the same drawing resolution.

C1.title: Isolated concentric sphere
C1.notes: No plate-specific calibration. This isolates the sphere from M5's tube and annotations.

S101.title: Stippled brush, sphere and tube
S101.notes: No extra per-plate overrides. The existing Typst density defaults were calibrated previously; they are not upstream parameters. The source uses one global RNG, while Typst uses separate keyed streams.

M8.title: L'Hôpital pulley composites
M8.notes: Uses the source 2.5 mm hatched beam band and 3× minimum rope width. PulleyWheel supplies the thin outer rim; the rope-occlusion silhouette now uses the source support-arc verticals intersected with the outer rim, while the shaded-wheel mask is still approximated through draw order. The support is outlined with source thinpen width. The default L'Hôpital figure omits the non-source l/m labels and uses source-mapped A/B/C offsets; optional length-labels: true retains l/m labels. At 600 ppi whole-plate RMSE is 0.11833 (previous 0.12579), with ink coverage 1.734% vs 2.116%; left/right crop RMSE is 0.13227/0.10421.

M9.title: Wood-grain panels
M9.notes: The source driver sets woodBlockRes to 1 mm for all four 1 mm-grid panels; the Typst source-res parameter matches that override. Source-space knot field values use the grid index, 0.2 detail scale, source angle convention and reflected landscape transform. A 72-sample source/Typst grid probe has mean error 0.00029 normalized (max 0.00151); the clipped marching-squares baseline matches the reversed 19-cell source sequence, with per-cell range error 1.54e-5 mean and 4.92e-5 max. Source contour thresholds preserve the fractional phase of the field maximum and subtract source jitter. Source-traced panel stream offsets are [0,1456,2823,4120]. Rounding cell field values and brush widths to 16.16 lowers 600 ppi whole-plate RMSE from 0.212745 to 0.212742; iterative cLine traversal with the reversed source-time width profile lowers it to 0.211560. M9 ink coverage is 3.7120% vs 4.2032% source. The first source-walk path has 22 points, mean/max source-point distance 0.00197/0.00465 mm, and a 17.2651 mm root (source 17.2808 mm). Full-path brushing and recursive tree matching remain open.

M10.title: Mechanical and optical primitives
M10.notes: The M10 hanging weight uses the source radius 2/5(h−2 mm), 1/4 neck radius, expanding shoulder, 2 mm body start and auricle capsule sized from 2*shadingDensity. At 600 ppi the full-plate RMSE is 0.07533 (previously 0.07549), and spring/weight crop RMSE is 0.09878 (previously 0.09909). Auricle interior shading and lens curves, arrowheads and labels still use native algorithms.

M11.title: Globe, eye, knot and refraction
M11.notes: Uses all eight upstream coast polylines. M11 sets coast-step to 0 so projected coast paths connect the source vertices directly. Globe latitude strokes use separate source-style land/ocean masks with p1-then-p2 RNG order. Coast brush width now uses the source projected sphere normal and light dot product; coast ink coverage is 25.21% vs 25.94%, but globe crop RMSE rises from 0.19545 to 0.19720. Knot strands use 385 source-curve samples per strand at 1/16 path-time intervals; compared with the prior 193-point 1/8-step fixture, knot crop RMSE falls from 0.05979 to 0.05904 and whole-plate RMSE from 0.11490 to 0.11483. `path-times:` maps these points onto the source's 24 path intervals. Mask mode partitions at crossing-interval midpoints, sorts by source layer, erases previous ink with higher tube silhouettes, and redraws hatch. Crossings are sampled and tube silhouettes remain approximate. Eye is 0.23617 and refraction 0.08193.

S102.title: Tube outline and cast shadow
S102.notes: The source tube follows two MetaPost smooth cubic joins; Typst samples the same Hobby path at per: 64. Same sphere size, mask polygon and source shadow depth. Tube crop RMSE is 0.01821 with 0.6195% vs 0.6208% dark coverage; the sphere remains the larger residual (0.09110 crop RMSE), where shadow projection differs.

S103.title: Solid and glass surface fills
S103.notes: Same source paths, polygons, hatch angles and styles. Defaults follow upstream stroke and row scales, and glass uses the upstream four-row dash cycle. At 600 ppi whole-plate RMSE is 0.21682 (baseline 0.23772); glass RMSE fell to 0.23791 and coverage is 3.87% vs 3.64% source.

S104.title: Flat surfaces
S104.notes: The source +30° hatch maps to -30° on the Typst page because the fixture flips its vertical axis. The MetaPost RNG mode reverses row traversal and uses its random pathSubdivide count (3 + round(uniformdeviate(2))) for each hatch. Unit-aware 16.16 thin-brush width-level rounding gives a 600 ppi hatch crop RMSE of 0.07530 with ink coverage 14.36% vs 14.07% source; stipple coverage remains close (7.14% vs 7.08%). Whole-plate RMSE is 0.20703 with ink coverage 10.81% vs 10.63%. Some brush recursion and local random details still differ.

S105.title: Wood block and surface
S105.notes: The plank and wooden surface use the source knot-warped field, the source-default 1/3 mm woodBlockRes, source-phased contour levels and reflected landscape knot transform. Field offsets consume one random value per source column. The source woodenSurface consumes 536 global random calls through the plank; the first surface knot matches its traced source coordinate within 0.001 mm. Both use the explicit contour-brush cell-range mode and source-scaled 16.16 width levels. Quantizing source-scaled cell values and dimensional brush widths lowers 600 ppi whole-plate RMSE from 0.102450 to 0.102443; source-walk with source-time widths lowers it to 0.102148. The block crop remains 0.127927, surface crop improves 0.077655 to 0.076936, and surface ink coverage moves from 0.5437% to 0.5309% toward 0.4892% source. Full-plate ink coverage is 0.6891% vs 0.74053% source; retain the source-time profile with these region and coverage tradeoffs recorded. Brush recursion remains approximate.

S106.title: Standing and hanging weights
S106.notes: The standing weight rises from its base and uses the source radius 2/5h. The hanging weight uses the source radius 2/5(h−2 mm), 1/4 neck radius, expanding shoulder, 2 mm body start and an auricle capsule sized from 2*shadingDensity. At 600 ppi full-plate RMSE is 0.07663 (previously 0.07679). Standing crop RMSE is 0.09949 with ink coverage 1.474% vs 1.594% source; hanging crop RMSE is 0.06998 with coverage 1.263% vs 1.131%. Auricle interior shading and tube hatch profiles remain approximate.

S107.title: Wheels and centroid
S107.notes: Both wheels now use upstream radial ring ranges and widths. At 600 ppi pulley-wheel RMSE is 0.09105 with 3.95% coverage vs 3.83% source; wheel RMSE is 0.12807 with 6.03% vs 7.10%. Centroid geometry is shared.

S108.title: Lens and annotation variants
S108.notes: Same convex, concave and plano lens dimensions and annotation geometry; curve and arrow construction differ.
